accuracy.evidence: Checked 618 against CCSS 2.OA.2 (fluently add and subtract within 20; know from memory all sums of two one-digit numbers). Worked facts: 6+6=12 … 9+9=18; near-double 7+8=15; 9+6=15; related 16−7=9 from 9+7; max one-digit sum 9+9=18 within 20.

misconceptions.evidence: Targets sticking digits (9+6 as 96), always recounting every counter, treating fluency as only make-10 pairs, and losing the three-number link in related subtraction. Lab myth step and challenge tags (stick/count/only/echo) name each slip.

lab_distinct.evidence: flagsum20 is doubles / near-doubles / snap memory for one-digit sums; flagw20 teaches make-ten and break-to-ten computing strategies; flagsum10 stops at facts ≤10; flagnb20 is exact partner bonds. Mechanism is memorised anchors, not strategy teaching.

lab_teaches.evidence: Learner reveals doubles on a wall, opens near-double 7+8 from double 7, snaps 9+6, derives 16−7, picks a true one-digit sum, and rejects 'always recount' — moving from strategy to known fact.

predictions.evidence: Six predictions with tempting wrong options: 88 for 8+8, 78 for 7+8, 96 for 9+6, echo/add for related take-away, two-digit addend as 'within 20', and recount-as-fluency.

challenge_feedback.evidence: Challenge tags stick/diff/add/echo/count/only/zero each get their own message: digit-sticking, wrong operation, repeated addend, recount myth, doubles-only myth.

readability.evidence: Kid text uses short sentences and exact terms: fluent, double, near-double, related facts, within 20. Adult names CCSS 2.OA.2 and four mistakes. Ages 7–8.

no_filler.evidence: No filler phrases. Each kid paragraph teaches one idea (fluency, doubles, near-doubles, related facts); adult covers standard, anchors, mistakes, lab.

mobile.evidence: Young layout, large option rows, doubles dots readable at 390 px, every action has a button twin; challenge uses fl-pick buttons.

accessibility.evidence: Button twins for doubles, near-double and all choices; canvas aria-label via say(); walk.cjs axe WCAG 2.1 AA.

sources: CCSS Math 2.OA.2: fluently add and subtract within 20 using mental strategies; by end of Grade 2, know from memory all sums of two one-digit numbers
Department for Education, National Curriculum in England: mathematics Year 2 — recall and use addition and subtraction facts to 20 fluently
